visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a fist with three rounded finger bumps and two knuckle lines on the right, thumb raised with a rounded tip; reads as thumbs up like the reference. The rejected drawing was a blocky L with a single short line.
omissions: The reference's fourth finger bump is merged into the top of the fist (three 8-tall bumps fit).
drawing_plan: SQUARE: fist back x 6 with r4 corners, bottom y 42; thumb back edge (12,20)-(20,10), r4 tip to y 6, front edge to a crease at (31,18); finger bumps r4 at x 38 for y 18..42; knuckle lines y 26/34 from x 38 to 30.
